csv_project_name: AE for RFP/AE: Turn-Key Solar Photovoltaic (PV) Services
csv_scope_of_work: The City of Stillwater ( City ) is requesting proposals from qualified firms to provide turn-key solar photovoltaic (PV) services. The City seeks a qualified company to design, engineer, schedule, permit, and construct one or more rooftop solar PV arrays to serve one or more City facilities. The City expects on-site solar generation to provide long-term financial benefits by reducing energy costs, peak demand, and daily electricity use. The project is also intended to provide reliable, low-impact power and demonstrate the City s leadership in renewable energy.
csv_disciplines_requested: Architecture Services, Programming, Civil Engineering, Construction/Project Management, Electrical Engineering, Energy Engineering, Structural Engineering
